# Kyoto 3-Day Low-Cost Trip Plan

A relaxed, budget-conscious Kyoto itinerary for 2 adults, centered on temples, walkable neighborhoods, local food, and one museum.
**Budget target:** about **USD 900 total** excluding international flights.

# Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Cost Plan

## Day 1 — Higashiyama Temples + Gion Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka, Ninenzaka, Yasaka Pagoda area
- **Afternoon:** Kodai-ji, Maruyama Park, Yasaka Shrine, Gion strolling
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f8/A199_Japan_Kyoto_Maruyama_Park_Gion_Ar%C3%A9a_%284764445344%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Kodai-ji, Maruyama Park, Yasaka Shrine, Gion strolling, Kyoto, Japan
- **Evening food:** simple set dinner near Gion or Kawaramachi

Estimated costs for 2 adults:
- **Transport:** **JPY 1,200** / **USD 8**
- **Attractions:** **JPY 2,800** / **USD 19**
- **Food:** **JPY 7,200** / **USD 49**
- **Day total:** **JPY 11,200** / **USD 76**

Action: [Button: Kiyomizu area map](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Kiyomizu-dera+Kyoto)

## Day 2 — Fushimi Inari + Central Kyoto + Museum
- **Morning:** Fushimi Inari Shrine early, then train back toward central Kyoto
- **Afternoon:** Kyoto National Museum or Kyoto Railway Museum, plus a riverside or shopping-street walk
- **Evening food:** ramen, udon, or donburi in Kyoto Station area

Estimated costs for 2 adults:
- **Transport:** **JPY 1,400** / **USD 10**
- **Attractions:** **JPY 3,200** / **USD 22**
- **Food:** **JPY 6,800** / **USD 46**
- **Day total:** **JPY 11,400** / **USD 78**

Action: [Button: Museum options](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Kyoto+museum)

## Day 3 — Arashiyama + Zen Walks
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Morning:** Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji area, river walk
- **Afternoon:** Okochi Sanso Garden or Sagano neighborhood stroll, optional temple stop
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/99/Wooden_gate_in_Okochi_Sanso_Garden%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Okochi Sanso Garden or Sagano neighborhood stroll, optional temple stop, Kyoto, Japan
- **Evening food:** casual izakaya-style meal or curry near your base

Estimated costs for 2 adults:
- **Transport:** **JPY 1,800** / **USD 12**
- **Attractions:** **JPY 2,400** / **USD 16**
- **Food:** **JPY 7,000** / **USD 48**
- **Day total:** **JPY 11,200** / **USD 76**

Action: [Button: Arashiyama route](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Arashiyama+Kyoto)

## Trip Cost Snapshot
| Category | JPY | USD |
|---|---:|---:|
| Transport | 4,400 | 30 |
| Attractions | 8,400 | 57 |
| Food | 21,000 | 143 |
| 3-day total | 33,800 | 230 |

**Budget note:** This itinerary leaves a large cushion for hotel, snacks, taxis, shopping, or a nicer dinner while still staying well under **USD 900** total.

# Packing Checklist and Rain Backup Plan

## Packing Checklist
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/umbrella.svg
- Comfortable walking shoes with good grip
- Light rain jacket or compact umbrella
- Easy-on/off socks for temples and indoor spots
- Small daypack
- Portable charger and charging cable
- Reusable water bottle
- Cash in small yen notes and coins
- Light layers for cool mornings and evenings
- Tissues and hand sanitizer
- Basic meds and blister care

## Rain Backup Plan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-rain.svg
- Swap outdoor temple walks for **Kyoto National Museum**, **Kyoto Railway Museum**, or **Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art**
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/a/a9/JR_West_223-2000_W18_Kyoto_Railway_Museum.JPG Alt=Swap outdoor temple walks for **Kyoto National Museum**, **Kyoto Railway Museum**, or **Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art, Kyoto, Japan
- Use **Kyoto Station**, **Teramachi**, and **Shinkyogoku** for covered shopping and food
- Replace Arashiyama walking with **Tenryu-ji interior areas**, cafés, and train-based sightseeing
- Keep one flexible block each day so you can move the most weather-sensitive stop earlier or later
- If rain is steady, focus on **museum + food + short shrine visits** rather than long neighborhood walks

# Cost-Saving Tips for Kyoto

- Use trains and buses only when needed; Kyoto is very walkable in the core districts
- Eat lunch sets at local restaurants for the best value
- Visit temples early to avoid crowds and reduce transit backtracking
Media: Alt=Visit temples early to avoid crowds and reduce transit backtracking, Kyoto, Japan
- Pick one paid museum and keep the rest of the trip mostly free or low-fee
- Buy snacks at convenience stores for breakfast or between meals

# Useful Sources

- Kyoto City tourism: https://kyoto.travel/en
- Kyoto City bus and transport info: https://www.city.kyoto.lg.jp/kotsu/page/0000285079.html
- Kyoto National Museum: https://www.kyohaku.go.jp/eng/
- Kyoto Railway Museum: https://www.kyotorailwaymuseum.jp/en/
